system.description:
A sharpened wooden shaft — no great weapon against mortals, but every Kindred's nightmare.

Negative Traits: Short

Concealability: Jacket

Damage: One lethal health level

Availability: Any

Special Ability - Staking: Can pierce the heart of a vampire (paralyzing her) if the wielder wins or ties two successive Simple Tests after striking.
system.source: Faith and Fire (Dark Ages), Rules, Systems and Drama
